name: Underfolk
printedArtCredit: Jeff Miracola, p. 109 unnamed Underfolk barbarian
sourceDistinctions: The contents point to p. 109. The traits are on printed p. 110.
Rocky terrain replaces the +4 Camouflage bonus with a total of +10. True seeing negates it.
Dazzled gives −1 on attacks, Search, and Spot. Light Sensitivity does not use the Sharakim’s attack-only text.
The printed racial list gives Drow as a bonus language. Undercommon appears in the cultural prose.
The first printing gives no natural armor, ability-score adjustment or level adjustment. The NPC example artwork has no printed stat block.
portraitForm: Berren Shalebank, an original Underfolk Expert
